purpose: Test one loss factor that gives larger signed endpoint movements more influence while retaining the existing direction head, inputs, architecture, masks and 1/5/15-minute baseline.

motivation.sign_only: The existing BCE gives +0.1 and +50 bps the same positive class.
motivation.observed_first_hit: The original five-minute score AUC is 0.426768 on 1042 observed first-hurdle sides; 1017 agree with terminal sign. This is conditional reused development, not causal proof.
motivation.counterevidence: An auxiliary signed-bps mean MSE and three passes did not demonstrate improved later direction. Weighted sign is a distinct hypothesis, not a claimed fix.

formula.eligible: observed AND sign != 0 AND terminal_time strictly before the own TRAIN cutoff
formula.r: absolute original signed midpoint return in bps
formula.s_h: own TRAIN-prefix RMS bps per horizon from the existing checked float32-target scale
formula.normalizer: mean of raw_weight over that horizon own eligible TRAIN-prefix cells; fail closed if zero or nonfinite
formula.loss: sum of weight times original BCE-with-logits over eligible cells, divided by eligible-cell count
properties: Nonnegative and bounded without a fixed bps trade threshold.
Each horizon has mean weight 1 on its own eligible TRAIN prefix; batch effects and gradient geometry may still differ.
Forward inputs, original sign label, head output and chronological split stay unchanged.
This targets a magnitude-tilted sign probability, not the ordinary unweighted up probability, an action or exact expected cash return.

planned_comparison.only_intended_factor: bounded TRAIN-prefix-normalized magnitude weighting of direction BCE; same fresh initialization, head, order, feature view, optimizer and cutoff
secondary: fixed previously observed 10bps first-hurdle cohort as exploratory only
own prior and unchanged one-pass baseline
planned_comparison.inference: paired fixed UTC-day and UTC-week block intervals, observation identities verified before masks; no threshold, horizon, checkpoint or seed search
planned_comparison.success_standard: An improved research candidate needs a predeclared positive paired later-direction ranking difference in both clock-block intervals and no hidden regression in unweighted proper scores; no economic or production claim. Failure to meet this gate is inconclusive about other methods.
stops: Stop on target, cutoff, source, initialization, gradient, resume, mask, resource, time or parity mismatch.
Do not train until separately bound synthetic and genuine private initialization, gradient, and resume qualification pass.
Do not relaunch consumed plans; keep TEST, CONTROL and trading closed.

future_scope: The design is a controlled 1/5/15 diagnostic, not implementation of the requested all-1..60-minute head or first-hit/FLAT trading objective.
